title: Science fiction hexagonal hull panels
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of science fiction hull plating built from hexagonal panels: bevelled rims, inset plates, vents, bolts, panel lights and optionally glowing seams in the emissive map. Use for spaceships, armour, bases and game environments.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python scifi_hex_panels.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: hexes_across
parameters.meaning: Hexagons across the tile (7, 12, 14, 19 or 26 keep them closest to regular).

parameters.name: seam_width
parameters.meaning: Gap between panels, in hexagon widths.

parameters.name: bevel
parameters.meaning: Width of the bevelled rim, in hexagon widths.

parameters.name: light_share
parameters.meaning: Share of panels with a glowing inset.

parameters.name: vent_share
parameters.meaning: Share of panels with vent slots.

parameters.name: wear
parameters.meaning: Scuffed paint on the rims, showing metal.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo and glow in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Light grey hull with cyan panel lights.

presets.name: dark_reactor
presets.description: Dark panels with orange glowing seams.

presets.name: white_lab
presets.description: Clean white panels with fine seams and few details.

presets.name: military_olive
presets.description: Olive drab armour hexes, bolted and scuffed.

limits: The hexagonal lattice is squashed slightly to repeat on a square tile: about 1 percent for 7, 12, 14, 19 or 26 hexagons across, up to 15 percent for 3, 4 or 6. Panel types are chosen at random, with no hierarchy of large and small panels. Lights and glowing seams are emissive colour, not light sources. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Hexagonal Worley lattice with an even row count for periodicity
Cell-border distance for bevels and inset plates
Emissive map for lights and seams
